primary_step: max wall milliseconds over eight ranks at each step, through device completion
per_run_primary: arithmetic mean of twenty measured world-max steps
point_primary: arithmetic mean of the three independent run means
error_bars: min/max independent run means, not a confidence interval
normalized_denominator: primary-bank MoonEP-planner MaxVio0.2 point mean, one common denominator for every curve
pointwise_speedup: MoonEP-planner point mean at the same MaxVio / policy point mean
stable_point: four paired run-mean improvements are all positive and their median is at least0.01
best_existing: minimum geometric mean normalized time over six primary MaxVio points; failed points prevent complete-matrix best status
failed_point_display: explicit failure marker/status; never interpolated as a measured value
diagnostic_timing: separate from formal TimerOFF full-step results
